segments.text: Orca is a desktop workspace for running several coding agents side by side with each task isolated in its own git work tree. You can fan one prompt across five
agents, compare their changes, annotate diffs, and merge the result you trust. A mobile companion lets you monitor jobs and send follow-ups, while SSH work
trees move execution to a remote
